content:
We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for template that when applied to molecule reproduces the reaction: TMSOTf protecting alcohols. We have previous step: make_5_lvl2-apply_template-3 gave precursors list: a single SMILES: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C[C@@H]2O[C@H]2/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](OC(=O)CP(=O)(CC(F)(F)F)CC(F)(F)F)[C@H]1C)CO'

That is the precursor(s) after applying template? Actually apply_template returns precursors given target molecule and template. So they applied some template to target molecule (the original molecule) and got that precursor. Now we need to find the template that does this transformation (protecting alcohol). We need mapped_rxn associated with that template. We need template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash) as integer.

We need to search template catalog by criteria: broken functional group aliphatic hydroxyls, formed O-Si bond, broken O-Si? Actually forward reaction: O-Si bond formed, O-H broken (hydroxyl broken). So broken functional group: aliphatic hydroxyls. Formed functional group: maybe silyl ether? Not in list? The functional groups list includes maybe "silyl ethers"? Not sure. But we can search with functional_groups_broken = "aliphatic hydroxyls". Also bonds broken: O-H? bonds formed: O-Si. Let's try search_template_catalog_by_criteria.
